'''2020 MPC Patrick Johnson DS Senate Occupied''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Patrick Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Senate Occupied Johnson DS 2020 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162034/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
